intended_use.value: The agent is meant for the accounts payable team to use in triaging supplier invoices. It will read the supplier, amount, due date, and any notes for each invoice and sort it into one of three queues: URGENT, NORMAL, or ON HOLD.

limitations.value: The agent cannot perform any actions beyond sorting invoices into queues. It may get wrong if the information on the invoice is unclear or missing.

out_of_scope_uses.value: The agent must not be used for approving, scheduling, or making payments, or for changing supplier details.

purpose.value: The agent is for reading incoming supplier invoices and sorting them into urgent, normal, and on-hold queues for the accounts payable team.
